issues.explanation: Accepted Chapter 64 says Yang Fu's seven brothers were engaged, six died, and Yang Fu survived. The source says Yang Fu's seven brothers were all killed; Yang Fu himself survived after being wounded five times.
issues.suggested_fix: Change to: “杨阜与七个兄弟一同截击，七人皆被马超杀死；杨阜身中五枪，仍坚持死战，后因夏侯渊赶到而得以逃生。”
